statements.__comment: Create HAS relationship from lambda functions to the associated ECR image. Accounts are owned through the AWSOrganization; ECRImage.id is the image digest (indexed).
statements.query:
MATCH (:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID})-[:OWNER]->(:AWSOrganization{id: $ORGANIZATION_ID})-[:OWNER]->(aa:AWSAccount{id: $AWS_ID})-[:RESOURCE]->(l:AWSLambda) 
 WITH COLLECT(l) as lambda_list 
 UNWIND lambda_list as lambda 
 MATCH (e:ECRImage{id: 'sha256:' + lambda.codesha256}) 
 MERGE (lambda)-[r:HAS]->(e) 
 SET r.lastupdated = $UPDATE_TAG
